mapper.select: SELECT q_code, keyword, response_msg, hit_count, use_yn, img_url, link_url FROM chatbot_quest ORDER BY q_code DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chatbot_quest (q_code, keyword, response_msg, hit_count, use_yn, img_url, link_url) VALUES (SEQ_CHATBOT_QUEST.NEXTVAL, #{keyword}, #{response_msg}, 0, 'Y', #{img_url}, #{link_url})
mapper.update: UPDATE chatbot_quest SET keyword = #{keyword}, response_msg = #{response_msg}, link_url = #{link_url}, img_url = NVL(#{img_url, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, img_url) WHERE q_code = #{q_code}
